Direct ruling on the flagged item (finance-q6-02, the $62K Bristow deferred-revenue reclass): it does NOT rest on unsupported silence — it rests on two positive facts plus an exhaustive negative search. (1) Karen's Jul 9 message (c60f18c2e4b60012) makes the $62K entry explicitly conditional: 'If Sam signs off... I'll book the entry before we close Friday... Haven't heard back from him yet.' Financials going out to Sam and the board deck folder this afternoon,' shows the close proceeded without ever circling back to say the condition was met. I then swept the whole mailbox for closure: every message to/from Sam Greer (26 messages, none mention Bristow, the reclass, or a recognition-trigger sign-off), every message from Karen Voss from Jul 9 onward (including 'July close — status and open items' on Aug 3, which lists three different open items — AR write-off, payroll accrual, T&E — and never mentions the reclass either as done or still open), the Aug 3 'July trial balance export' and its Aug 7 delivery (the attached CSV shows only an aggregate Deferred Revenue balance, no line-item detail that would confirm or deny the entry), and the entire FY26 audit PBC correspondence (a different fiscal year's audit, no Bristow mention). Per QUESTIONS.md's own rule ('Silence does not close an obligation... stays open... until a message closes or retracts it'), the item is correctly open, correctly tiered must_include, and correctly anchored. Recommend no change to finance-q6-02.
